{{Money|1,000}} (Group Bonus) |shared_cash = 50% |music-1 = '''Ambience''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Not-so Mystical Woods|center|250px|thumb]] |music-2 = '''Final Wave ([[Swamp Monster]])''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Who Lurks There?|center|250px|thumb]] |music-ingame-2 = '''Final Wave ([[Swamp Monster]])''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Swamp Monster In-Game|center|250px|thumb]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Foggy Forest''' was the event [[Maps|map]] for the second night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. Like other event maps, it had a specialized wave structure with special [[enemies]]. Players started with {{Money|900}} ({{Money|1,000}} if the player joined Paradoxum Games) at the start of the game. Upon triumphing, you were awarded with {{Coins|150}}, {{Exp|50}} and {{SolarShard|160 Solar Shards}}. Losing on wave 12 awarded {{SolarShard|120 Solar Shards}} instead. This map used the [[Swamp Monster (Narrator)|Swamp Monster]] as its narrator, instead of the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]]. ==Design & Path== '''Foggy Forest''' was a large forest. Three large mushrooms, one red, one blue, and one grey, could be seen on the map and used as cliff spots. Multiple trees and smaller fungi could also be seen scattered along the map. The path started and ended at two caves, the path took a turn right and went straight. It then took the smaller circle on the left and then the bigger circle on the right. After that, it went straight and then took a left turn to the exit. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Foggy Forest}} ==Story== After defeating the [[Jaxe (Solar Eclipse)|Jaxe]], the [[T.D.S. Organization]] continues their journey to the [[Totality Tower]]. They are, however, stopped by the [[Swamp Monster]] and its army. The [[T.D.S. Organization]] fights them off and eventually defeats the [[Swamp Monster]]. ==Rewards== The game calculated how much {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you received based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (08:00 UTC Friday – 08:00 UTC Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 1.5x. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x. Any rewards that ended in a decimal point was rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:0 auto;" !Currency !Equation |- |{{Coins|Coins}} |{{Coins|50}} × (Waves/12)^1.75 + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Only) |- |{{Exp|}} |Waves 0-9: {{Exp|2.083}} × Waves
Waves 10-12: {{Exp|4.167}} × Waves |- |{{SolarShard|Solar Shards}} |{{SolarShard|120}} × (Waves/12)^1.75 + {{SolarShard|40}} (Triumph Only) |} ==Wave Structure== Formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave was: :({{Money|220}} + ({{Money|75}} × Waves Completed)) ÷ Players The waves in '''Foggy Forest''' could not be skipped. They followed these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="margin:0 auto; width:50%" !Waves !Wave Timer |- |1-11 |1:00 |- |12 |N/A |} '''Bolded''' names indicates an enemy type's debut. ----

==Strategy== *There is a visual bug where the [[Accelerator]] seems to not target the [[Swamp Monster]], the major boss of the map. This has no impact on the performance of the [[Accelerator]] and it will still deal damage to it, so it is a viable option. **Due to its expensive price, it is recommended to place it later on. *Wave 5 can cripple or defeat players due to the spawned [[Ghost (Solar Eclipse)|Ghosts]]. **Multiple Level 3 [[Scout]]s or [[Crook Boss]]es are a good counter to this. For later waves, they should be upgraded to Level 4. *Since the path goes through the middle of the path twice, it is recommended to place your towers near it. *The [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]] can be useful in this map, as the path goes in circles. *You can place down cliff towers such as the [[Ranger]] on the giant fungi near the path. *The [[Mortar]] can help clear out early waves, however it will struggle against the [[Ghost (Solar Eclipse)|Ghosts]] due to them being a hidden enemy with [[Splash Damage]] immunity. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Executioner - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Foggy Forest''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Solar Eclipse Trailer|'''Foggy Forest''' in the game trailer. }} ==Update History== *'''6 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]b **'''Foggy Forest''' added. *'''26 January 2022''' [[v1.0.1]] **'''Foggy Forest''' removed. {{SolarEclipseMaps|[[Rotfield]]|Night I|'''Foggy Forest'''|Night II|[[Tower Outskirts]]|Night III}} {{MapNavBox}}
